name.description: Human-readable name for pull requests and issues. Defaults to the package.

auto.description: Which releases are automatic updates: patch keeps the first two version parts (4.0.x), minor the first (4.x), major nothing; none makes every release a deliberate upgrade. Required for exact pins; otherwise implied by devbox.json.

group.description: Packages with the same group are updated in one pull request.

checks.description: What must exist before moving to a version: docker:IMAGE, url:URL or setup-ruby. {version} is replaced with the version.

after_update.description: Command to run after pulling an update, shown in pull requests, e.g. "bundle install".

files.description: Other files that pin the version.

path.description: File to update, relative to the project root.

match.description: Perl regex matching exactly one line; capture group 1 is the pinned version.

replace.description: Replacement for the matched text; {version} is the new version.

parts.description: Pin only the first N version parts (1 for node:24).
